pagerbot: [ALERT] auth-service unexpected spike: /v1/session/token 11.2k reqs in 12m, err_ratio up, source IPs: 172.31.45.21, 34.89.10.22, 52.10.99.3. Paging eng-security & oncall-sre.

 dmitri: Acknowledged. Running audit queries now.

 dmitri: Query: `rictl audit query "event:auth.token.create AND src_ip:(172.31.45.21 OR 34.89.10.22 OR 52.10.99.3)" --since 15m` -> ~410 token creates; patterns show reuse and short-lived tokens; user-agents `curl/7.68.0`, `python-requests/2.25`.

 carol: Metrics: auth latency tail increased for /v1/session/*, error spike is mostly 403 and 429. No 5xx.

 alice: Support: two tenants reporting login timeouts (INC-4492, INC-4493). Blocking those IPs might impact legit users; need scope.

 bob: Recommend immediate mitigations: per-path rate-limit for /v1/session/token, WAF geo block for the suspect IPs, and temporary stricter auth TTL checks. Can push now?

 carol: Applying quick WAF rule and path-level rate-limit. `wafctl apply -r auth-suspect --ips 172.31.45.21,34.89.10.22,52.10.99.3 --path /v1/session/token` -> done :white_check_mark:

 dmitri: Correlation: found svc-analytics-key1 used at 15:02 UTC from 34.89.10.22. `rictl audit query "actor:svc-analytics-key1 AND event:auth.token.create" --since 30m` -> matches.

 eve: (eng-security) svc-analytics-key1 shows anomalous cross-region playback and requests with high concurrency. Recommend immediate revoke+rotate. Also search infra for key usages (cron jobs, analytics pipelines).

 carol: Revoked svc-analytics-key1: `rictl keys revoke --id svc-analytics-key1 --reason "suspected compromise"` -> success. Observability: no broad downstream failures observed in 60s.

 dmitri: Enabled canary read-only mode for affected tenants and set write endpoints to deny for those tenants. Follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-incident (see rotate-service-keys & put-tenant-readonly).

 frank: (legal/privacy) Preserve logs for forensic review. Ensure S3 retention and tag artifacts. Redact PII before any external communication. Loop in legal-privacy.

 alice: Drafted customer communication for impacted tenants. Holding send until scope confirmed. /cc @customer-success

 bob: Deploying runtime hotfix to reject token replay and tighten TTL checks. Canary deploy in progress, ETA ~8m. CI green.

 dmitri: Creating timeline and handoff notes. Artifacts archived s3://redwood-security-incidents/1717504321/. Next: rotate any other service keys with similar usage, search for IPs with same UA pattern.

 jess: Taking overnight on-call. Acknowledged. Will monitor for new token creation anomalies and suspicious IPs. Please DM urgent updates. :thumbsup:

 dmitri: Severity P2. Will keep channel open until 24h clear and a postmortem is scheduled. Adding initial findings to INC-1717504321.

 carol: Post-action: adjust WAF rule to a 429 throttle after 30m if no further abuse, and schedule key rotation sweep. Adding tasks to backlog and pinging infra owners.

 pagerbot: [RESOLVED?] alert suppressed after WAF and key revoke; continue monitoring.
